sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><description>Weather Widget — 3-tab portal card (Current, Hourly, Daily) powered by the Open-Meteo public API.</description><name>Weather Widget</name><id>weather-widget</id><template><div class="weather-widget-wrapper" ng-class="{'theme-dark': c.data.theme === 'dark'}">

  <!-- Header Bar -->
  <div class="ww-header">
    <div class="ww-header-logo">
      <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" class="ww-icon">
        <path fill="#fff" d="M6.76 4.84l-1.8-1.79-1.41 1.41 1.79 1.79 1.42-1.41zM4 10.5H1v2h3v-2zm9-9.95h-2V3.5h2V.55zm7.45 3.91l-1.41-1.41-1.79 1.79 1.41 1.41 1.79-1.79zm-3.21 13.7l1.79 1.8 1.41-1.41-1.8-1.79-1.4 1.4zM20 10.5v2h3v-2h-3zm-8-5c-3.31 0-6 2.69-6 6s2.69 6 6 6 6-2.69 6-6-2.69-6-6-6zm-1 16.95h2V19.5h-2v2.95zm-7.45-3.91l1.41 1.41 1.79-1.8-1.41-1.41-1.79 1.8z"/>
      </svg>
    </div>
    <span class="ww-header-title">{{c.data.widget_title || 'Weather'}}</span>
    <div class="ww-header-actions">
      <button class="ww-tab-btn" ng-class="{active: c.activeTab === 'current'}" ng-click="c.setTab('current')">Current</button>
      <button class="ww-tab-btn" ng-class="{active: c.activeTab === 'hourly'}" ng-click="c.setTab('hourly')">Hourly</button>
      <button class="ww-tab-btn" ng-class="{active: c.activeTab === 'daily'}" ng-click="c.setTab('daily')">Daily</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Loading State -->
  <div class="ww-loading" ng-if="c.loading">
    <i class="fa fa-circle-o-notch fa-spin fa-2x"></i>
    <p>Loading forecast…</p>
  </div>

  <!-- Error State -->
  <div class="ww-error" ng-if="!c.loading && c.error">
    <i class="fa fa-exclamation-triangle fa-2x"></i>
    <p>{{c.error}}</p>
    <button class="ww-btn ww-btn-outline" ng-click="c.load()">Retry</button>
  </div>

  <!-- ─── Tab: Current ─── -->
  <div class="ww-tab-content" ng-show="c.activeTab === 'current' && !c.loading && !c.error">

    <!-- Banner -->
    <div class="ww-banner" ng-class="{'ww-banner-night': c.current && !c.current.isDay}">
      <div class="ww-banner-overlay"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- Hero Card -->
    <div class="ww-hero">
      <div class="ww-hero-icon">
        <i class="fa {{c.current.weather.icon}}"></i>
      </div>
      <div class="ww-hero-temp">
        <span class="ww-temp-value">{{c.current.temperature | number:0}}</span>
        <span class="ww-temp-unit">{{c.tempUnit()}}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="ww-hero-info">
        <h2 class="ww-location-name">{{c.location.name}}<span ng-if="c.location.admin1">, {{c.location.admin1}}</span></h2>
        <p class="ww-location-country">{{c.location.country}}</p>
        <p class="ww-condition">{{c.current.weather.label}}</p>
        <p class="ww-feels-like">Feels like {{c.current.apparentTemperature | number:0}}{{c.tempUnit()}}</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Stat Grid -->
    <div class="ww-stat-grid">
      <div class="ww-stat-card">
        <div class="ww-stat-icon"><i class="fa fa-tint"></i></div>
        <div class="ww-stat-body">
          <h4>Humidity</h4>
          <p>{{c.current.humidity}}%</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="ww-stat-card">
        <div class="ww-stat-icon"><i class="fa fa-flag-o"></i></div>
        <div class="ww-stat-body">
          <h4>Wind</h4>
          <p>{{c.current.windSpeed | number:0}} {{c.windUnit()}}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="ww-stat-card">
        <div class="ww-stat-icon"><i class="fa fa-umbrella"></i></div>
        <div class="ww-stat-body">
          <h4>Precipitation</h4>
          <p>{{c.current.precipitation | number:1}} {{c.precipUnit()}}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="ww-stat-card">
        <div class="ww-stat-icon"><i class="fa fa-map-marker"></i></div>
        <div class="ww-stat-body">
          <h4>Coordinates</h4>
          <p>{{c.location.latitude | number:2}}, {{c.location.longitude | number:2}}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="ww-updated" ng-if="c.lastUpdated">
      Updated {{c.lastUpdated | date:'shortTime'}}
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ─── Tab: Hourly ─── -->
  <div class="ww-tab-content" ng-show="c.activeTab === 'hourly' && !c.loading && !c.error">
    <div class="ww-hourly-header">
      <span>Next 24 hours · {{c.location.name}}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="ww-hourly-scroll">
      <div class="ww-hourly-cell" ng-repeat="h in c.hourly track by $index">
        <div class="ww-hourly-time">{{h.hourLabel}}</div>
        <div class="ww-hourly-icon"><i class="fa {{h.weather.icon}}"></i></div>
        <div class="ww-hourly-temp">{{h.temp | number:0}}{{c.tempUnit()}}</div>
        <div class="ww-precip-bar" ng-if="c.showPrecip()">
          <div class="ww-precip-fill" ng-style="{height: (h.precipProb || 0) + '%'}"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="ww-precip-label" ng-if="c.showPrecip()">{{h.precipProb || 0}}%</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ─── Tab: Daily ─── -->
  <div class="ww-tab-content" ng-show="c.activeTab === 'daily' && !c.loading && !c.error">
    <div class="ww-daily-header">
      <span>7-day forecast · {{c.location.name}}</span>
    </div>

    <div class="ww-sun-row" ng-if="c.daily.length">
      <div class="ww-sun-item">
        <i class="fa fa-sun-o"></i>
        <span>Sunrise</span>
        <strong>{{c.formatTime(c.daily[0].sunrise)}}</strong>
      </div>
      <div class="ww-sun-item">
        <i class="fa fa-moon-o"></i>
        <span>Sunset</span>
        <strong>{{c.formatTime(c.daily[0].sunset)}}</strong>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="ww-daily-row" ng-repeat="d in c.daily track by $index">
      <div class="ww-daily-day">{{d.dayLabel}}</div>
      <div class="ww-daily-icon"><i class="fa {{d.weather.icon}}"></i></div>
      <div class="ww-daily-cond">{{d.weather.label}}</div>
      <div class="ww-daily-precip" ng-if="d.precip > 0">
        <i class="fa fa-tint"></i> {{d.precip | number:1}} {{c.precipUnit()}}
      </div>
      <div class="ww-daily-temps">
        <span class="ww-temp-min">{{d.tempMin | number:0}}°</span>
        <span class="ww-temp-max">{{d.tempMax | number:0}}°</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Footer -->
  <div class="ww-footer">
    <span>Powered by</span>
    <a href="https://open-meteo.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Open-Meteo</a>
  </div>

</div>
</template><css>/* =============================================
   Weather Widget — ServiceNow Portal
   Powered by Open-Meteo
   ============================================= */

/* --- CSS Variables --- */
.weather-widget-wrapper {
  --ww-sky: #4a9eff;
  --ww-sky-dark: #2b6fb8;
  --ww-indigo: #3b5998;
  --ww-sky-light: #e6f1ff;
  --ww-black: #1b1f23;
  --ww-gray: #86888a;
  --ww-border: #e0e0e0;
  --ww-bg: #ffffff;
  --ww-card-bg: #ffffff;
  --ww-text: #1b1f23;
  --ww-text-muted: #6b7280;
  --ww-warn: #d97706;
  --ww-radius: 12px;
  --ww-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.10);
  --ww-transition: 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
  --ww-header-height: 56px;

  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--ww-text);
  background: var(--ww-bg);
  border-radius: var(--ww-radius);
  box-shadow: var(--ww-shadow);
  overflow: hidden;
  max-width: 680px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  position: relative;
}

/* Dark theme */
.weather-widget-wrapper.theme-dark {
  --ww-bg: #1b1f23;
  --ww-card-bg: #23282e;
  --ww-text: #e5e7eb;
  --ww-text-muted: #9ca3af;
  --ww-border: #374151;
  --ww-sky-light: #1e3a5f;
  --ww-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
}

/* --- Header --- */
.ww-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ww-sky) 0%, var(--ww-indigo) 100%);
  padding: 0 16px;
  height: var(--ww-header-height);
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 10;
}

.ww-icon {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.ww-header-title {
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 15px;
  flex: 1;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.ww-header-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
}

.ww-tab-btn {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--ww-transition), color var(--ww-transition);
}

.ww-tab-btn:hover,
.ww-tab-btn.active {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  color: #fff;
}

.ww-tab-btn.active {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
}

/* --- Tab Content Transition --- */
.ww-tab-content {
  animation: wwFadeIn 0.28s ease;
  padding: 0;
}

@keyframes wwFadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

/* --- Banner --- */
.ww-banner {
  width: 100%;
  height: 120px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4a9eff 0%, #3b5998 60%, #2c3e6b 100%);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.ww-banner-night {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e3a5f 0%, #14213d 60%, #0d1b2a 100%);
}

.ww-banner::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 30%, rgba(255,255,255,0.12) 0%, transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 20%, rgba(255,255,255,0.08) 0%, transparent 50%);
}

.ww-banner-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 40px;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--ww-bg), transparent);
}

/* --- Hero Card (Current tab) --- */
.ww-hero {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 18px;
  padding: 0 20px 16px;
  margin-top: -56px;
  position: relative;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.ww-hero-icon {
  width: 88px;
  height: 88px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: var(--ww-card-bg);
  border: 3px solid var(--ww-bg);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.18);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 44px;
  color: var(--ww-sky);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.theme-dark .ww-hero-icon {
  color: #fbbf24;
}

.ww-hero-temp {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 4px;
  color: var(--ww-text);
  font-weight: 200;
  line-height: 1;
}

.ww-temp-value {
  font-size: 56px;
  letter-spacing: -2px;
}

.ww-temp-unit {
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--ww-text-muted);
}

.ww-hero-info {
  flex: 1 1 200px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.ww-location-name {
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 0 2px;
  color: var(--ww-text);
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.ww-location-country {
  color: var(--ww-text-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
  margin: 0 0 6px;
}

.ww-condition {
  color: var(--ww-text);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  margin: 0 0 2px;
}

.ww-feels-like {
  color: var(--ww-text-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
  margin: 0;
}

/* --- Stat Grid (Current tab) --- */
.ww-stat-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 4px 20px 16px;
}

.ww-stat-card {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 12px;
  background: var(--ww-card-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--ww-border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  transition: box-shadow var(--ww-transition), transform var(--ww-transition);
}

.ww-stat-card:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(74,158,255,0.15);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.ww-stat-icon {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--ww-sky-light);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.ww-stat-icon .fa {
  color: var(--ww-sky);
  font-size: 15px;
}

.ww-stat-body h4 {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.07em;
  color: var(--ww-text-muted);
  margin: 0 0 4px;
}

.ww-stat-body p {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ww-text);
  margin: 0;
}

.ww-updated {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--ww-text-muted);
  padding: 0 20px 12px;
}

/* --- Hourly Tab --- */
.ww-hourly-header,
.ww-daily-header {
  padding: 16px 20px 8px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--ww-text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ww-border);
}

.ww-hourly-scroll {
  display: flex;
  overflow-x: auto;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 16px 12px;
  scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.ww-hourly-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar {
  height: 6px;
}

.ww-hourly-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: var(--ww-border);
  border-radius: 3px;
}

.ww-hourly-cell {
  flex: 0 0 64px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 8px 4px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  scroll-snap-align: start;
  transition: background var(--ww-transition);
}

.ww-hourly-cell:hover {
  background: var(--ww-sky-light);
}

.ww-hourly-time {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ww-text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.ww-hourly-icon .fa {
  font-size: 18px;
  color: var(--ww-sky);
}

.ww-hourly-temp {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ww-text);
}

.ww-precip-bar {
  width: 6px;
  height: 40px;
  background: var(--ww-border);
  border-radius: 3px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
}

.ww-precip-fill {
  width: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--ww-sky), var(--ww-indigo));
  transition: height var(--ww-transition);
}

.ww-precip-label {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--ww-sky);
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* --- Daily Tab --- */
.ww-sun-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-around;
  padding: 14px 20px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ww-border);
  background: var(--ww-sky-light);
}

.ww-sun-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--ww-text);
}

.ww-sun-item .fa {
  color: var(--ww-sky);
  font-size: 16px;
}

.ww-sun-item span {
  color: var(--ww-text-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
}

.ww-sun-item strong {
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ww-daily-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 70px 32px 1fr auto auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 14px 20px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ww-border);
  transition: background var(--ww-transition);
}

.ww-daily-row:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.ww-daily-row:hover {
  background: var(--ww-sky-light);
}

.ww-daily-day {
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--ww-text);
}

.ww-daily-icon .fa {
  font-size: 20px;
  color: var(--ww-sky);
}

.ww-daily-cond {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--ww-text-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.ww-daily-precip {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--ww-sky);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}

.ww-daily-temps {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  min-width: 70px;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

.ww-temp-min {
  color: var(--ww-text-muted);
}

.ww-temp-max {
  color: var(--ww-text);
}

/* --- Loading + Error States --- */
.ww-loading,
.ww-error {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 64px 20px;
  color: var(--ww-text-muted);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
}

.ww-loading .fa {
  color: var(--ww-sky);
}

.ww-error .fa {
  color: var(--ww-warn);
}

.ww-error p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  max-width: 360px;
}

/* --- Buttons --- */
.ww-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 8px 18px;
  border-radius: 24px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all var(--ww-transition);
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  background: transparent;
}

.ww-btn-outline {
  color: var(--ww-sky);
  border-color: var(--ww-sky);
}

.ww-btn-outline:hover {
  background: var(--ww-sky-light);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(74,158,255,0.15);
}

/* --- Footer --- */
.ww-footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 10px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ww-border);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--ww-text-muted);
  background: var(--ww-card-bg);
}

.ww-footer a {
  color: var(--ww-sky);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.ww-footer a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

/* --- Responsive --- */
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .ww-header-actions {
    display: none;
  }

  .ww-temp-value {
    font-size: 44px;
  }

  .ww-hero-icon {
    width: 72px;
    height: 72px;
    font-size: 36px;
  }

  .ww-stat-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .ww-daily-row {
    grid-template-columns: 60px 28px 1fr auto;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .ww-daily-cond {
    display: none;
  }
}

/* --- ServiceNow SP overrides --- */
.sp-widget-content .weather-widget-wrapper {
  max-width: 100%;
}
</css><client_script>/**
 * Weather Widget — Client-side Controller
 * ServiceNow Service Portal (AngularJS)
 *
 * Fetches geocoding + forecast from Open-Meteo directly from the browser.
 * No authentication required. ES5 syntax to stay consistent with widget-server.js.
 */
api.controller = function($scope, $http, $interval, $timeout) {
  var c = this;

  c.activeTab = 'current';
  c.loading = true;
  c.error = '';
  c.location = null;
  c.current = null;
  c.hourly = [];
  c.daily = [];
  c.lastUpdated = null;

  var GEOCODE_URL = 'https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search';
  var FORECAST_URL = 'https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast';

  // WMO weather code → label + Font Awesome 4.x icon class
  var WMO_CODES = {
    0:  { label: 'Clear sky',                       icon: 'fa-sun-o' },
    1:  { label: 'Mainly clear',                    icon: 'fa-sun-o' },
    2:  { label: 'Partly cloudy',                   icon: 'fa-cloud' },
    3:  { label: 'Overcast',                        icon: 'fa-cloud' },
    45: { label: 'Fog',                             icon: 'fa-align-justify' },
    48: { label: 'Depositing rime fog',             icon: 'fa-align-justify' },
    51: { label: 'Light drizzle',                   icon: 'fa-tint' },
    53: { label: 'Moderate drizzle',                icon: 'fa-tint' },
    55: { label: 'Dense drizzle',                   icon: 'fa-tint' },
    56: { label: 'Light freezing drizzle',          icon: 'fa-snowflake-o' },
    57: { label: 'Dense freezing drizzle',          icon: 'fa-snowflake-o' },
    61: { label: 'Light rain',                      icon: 'fa-tint' },
    63: { label: 'Moderate rain',                   icon: 'fa-tint' },
    65: { label: 'Heavy rain',                      icon: 'fa-umbrella' },
    66: { label: 'Light freezing rain',             icon: 'fa-snowflake-o' },
    67: { label: 'Heavy freezing rain',             icon: 'fa-snowflake-o' },
    71: { label: 'Light snow',                      icon: 'fa-snowflake-o' },
    73: { label: 'Moderate snow',                   icon: 'fa-snowflake-o' },
    75: { label: 'Heavy snow',                      icon: 'fa-snowflake-o' },
    77: { label: 'Snow grains',                     icon: 'fa-snowflake-o' },
    80: { label: 'Light rain showers',              icon: 'fa-tint' },
    81: { label: 'Moderate rain showers',           icon: 'fa-tint' },
    82: { label: 'Violent rain showers',            icon: 'fa-umbrella' },
    85: { label: 'Light snow showers',              icon: 'fa-snowflake-o' },
    86: { label: 'Heavy snow showers',              icon: 'fa-snowflake-o' },
    95: { label: 'Thunderstorm',                    icon: 'fa-bolt' },
    96: { label: 'Thunderstorm with slight hail',   icon: 'fa-bolt' },
    99: { label: 'Thunderstorm with heavy hail',    icon: 'fa-bolt' }
  };

  function describeCode(code) {
    return WMO_CODES[code] || { label: 'Unknown', icon: 'fa-question-circle-o' };
  }

  c.setTab = function(tab) {
    c.activeTab = tab;
  };

  c.unitsImperial = function() {
    return c.data.units === 'imperial';
  };

  c.tempUnit = function() {
    return c.unitsImperial() ? '°F' : '°C';
  };

  c.windUnit = function() {
    return c.unitsImperial() ? 'mph' : 'km/h';
  };

  c.precipUnit = function() {
    return c.unitsImperial() ? 'in' : 'mm';
  };

  c.showPrecip = function() {
    return String(c.data.show_precipitation).toLowerCase() !== 'false';
  };

  function geocode(city) {
    var params = { name: city, count: 1, language: 'en', format: 'json' };
    if (c.data.country_code) {
      params.country_code = c.data.country_code;
    }
    return $http.get(GEOCODE_URL, { params: params }).then(function(resp) {
      var results = resp.data && resp.data.results;
      if (!results || !results.length) {
        throw new Error('No results for city "' + city + '"');
      }
      return results[0];
    });
  }

  function fetchForecast(loc) {
    var imperial = c.unitsImperial();
    var params = {
      latitude: loc.latitude,
      longitude: loc.longitude,
      current: 'temperature_2m,relative_humidity_2m,apparent_temperature,is_day,precipitation,weather_code,wind_speed_10m',
      hourly: 'temperature_2m,precipitation_probability,weather_code',
      daily: 'weather_code,temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,precipitation_sum,sunrise,sunset',
      timezone: 'auto',
      forecast_days: 7,
      temperature_unit: imperial ? 'fahrenheit' : 'celsius',
      wind_speed_unit: imperial ? 'mph' : 'kmh',
      precipitation_unit: imperial ? 'inch' : 'mm'
    };
    return $http.get(FORECAST_URL, { params: params }).then(function(resp) {
      return resp.data;
    });
  }

  function buildHourly(forecast) {
    var times = forecast.hourly && forecast.hourly.time;
    if (!times) return [];
    // Find the index of the current hour (first slot >= now)
    var nowMs = Date.now();
    var startIdx = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < times.length; i++) {
      if (new Date(times[i]).getTime() >= nowMs - 3600000) {
        startIdx = i;
        break;
      }
    }
    var out = [];
    var endIdx = Math.min(startIdx + 24, times.length);
    for (var j = startIdx; j < endIdx; j++) {
      var d = new Date(times[j]);
      out.push({
        time: d,
        hourLabel: formatHourLabel(d),
        temp: forecast.hourly.temperature_2m[j],
        precipProb: forecast.hourly.precipitation_probability[j],
        weather: describeCode(forecast.hourly.weather_code[j])
      });
    }
    return out;
  }

  function buildDaily(forecast) {
    var times = forecast.daily && forecast.daily.time;
    if (!times) return [];
    var out = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < times.length; i++) {
      var d = new Date(times[i] + 'T00:00:00');
      out.push({
        date: d,
        dayLabel: formatDayLabel(d, i),
        tempMax: forecast.daily.temperature_2m_max[i],
        tempMin: forecast.daily.temperature_2m_min[i],
        precip: forecast.daily.precipitation_sum[i],
        weather: describeCode(forecast.daily.weather_code[i]),
        sunrise: forecast.daily.sunrise[i],
        sunset: forecast.daily.sunset[i]
      });
    }
    return out;
  }

  function formatHourLabel(d) {
    var h = d.getHours();
    var suffix = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
    var hh = h % 12 === 0 ? 12 : h % 12;
    return hh + ' ' + suffix;
  }

  function formatDayLabel(d, idx) {
    if (idx === 0) return 'Today';
    if (idx === 1) return 'Tomorrow';
    var days = ['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'];
    return days[d.getDay()];
  }

  function formatTime(iso) {
    if (!iso) return '';
    var d = new Date(iso);
    var h = d.getHours();
    var m = d.getMinutes();
    var suffix = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
    var hh = h % 12 === 0 ? 12 : h % 12;
    var mm = m < 10 ? '0' + m : m;
    return hh + ':' + mm + ' ' + suffix;
  }

  c.formatTime = formatTime;

  c.load = function() {
    c.error = '';
    if (!c.data.city) {
      c.loading = false;
      c.error = 'No city configured. Set the City option or weather.widget.city sys_property.';
      return;
    }
    c.loading = true;
    geocode(c.data.city)
      .then(function(loc) {
        c.location = loc;
        return fetchForecast(loc);
      })
      .then(function(forecast) {
        var cur = forecast.current || {};
        c.current = {
          temperature: cur.temperature_2m,
          apparentTemperature: cur.apparent_temperature,
          humidity: cur.relative_humidity_2m,
          precipitation: cur.precipitation,
          windSpeed: cur.wind_speed_10m,
          isDay: cur.is_day === 1,
          weather: describeCode(cur.weather_code)
        };
        c.hourly = buildHourly(forecast);
        c.daily = buildDaily(forecast);
        c.lastUpdated = new Date();
        c.loading = false;
      })
      .catch(function(err) {
        c.loading = false;
        c.error = (err && err.message) ? err.message : 'Could not load forecast.';
      });
  };

  // Auto-refresh
  var refreshHandle = null;
  function startAutoRefresh() {
    var minutes = parseInt(c.data.refresh_minutes, 10);
    if (!isNaN(minutes) && minutes > 0) {
      refreshHandle = $interval(c.load, minutes * 60 * 1000);
    }
  }

  $scope.$on('$destroy', function() {
    if (refreshHandle) {
      $interval.cancel(refreshHandle);
      refreshHandle = null;
    }
  });

  // Kick off initial load on next digest so c.data is fully bound
  $timeout(function() {
    c.load();
    startAutoRefresh();
  }, 0);
};
</client_script><script>/**
 * Weather Widget — Server-side Script
 * ServiceNow Service Portal
 *
 * Pass-through only: merges widget instance options with sys_property
 * defaults and hands a clean data object to the client controller.
 * All API calls happen client-side via $http (Open-Meteo, no auth).
 */
(function() {

  function sysProp(name, fallback) {
    var val = gs.getProperty(name, '');
    return val ? val : (fallback || '');
  }

  var opts = options || {};

  data.widget_title       = opts.widget_title       || sysProp('weather.widget.title', 'Weather');
  data.city               = opts.city               || sysProp('weather.widget.city', '');
  data.country_code       = opts.country_code       || sysProp('weather.widget.country_code', '');
  data.units              = opts.units              || sysProp('weather.widget.units', 'metric');
  data.theme              = opts.theme              || sysProp('weather.widget.theme', 'light');
  data.show_precipitation = opts.show_precipitation || sysProp('weather.widget.show_precipitation', 'true');
  data.refresh_minutes    = opts.refresh_minutes    || sysProp('weather.widget.refresh_minutes', '30');

})();
</script><option_schema>[
